name: Hida Defender School
abilityText: Ignore the Cumbersome quality of armor you wear. Once per round, before making a check to resist a critical strike, you may reduce the severity of that critical strike by the physical resistance of your armor plus your school rank (to a minimum of 0).
masteryAbility: At the beginning of your turn, you may spend 1 Void point. If you do, ignore all of your conditions, terrain, and negative persistent effects of techniques and abilities. Do not apply your disadvantages to checks. If you would die, you cling to life for a few moments longer instead (but still die when the effect ends). This effect persists until the end of your next turn.

name: Hida Battle Leader School
abilityText: Once per scene after you perform a Support action, you may choose any number of a character within a number of range bands equal to your ranks in Command. Each chosen character treats their composure as increased by your school rank. The effect persists until the end of the scene.
masteryAbility: Compromised characters affected by your school ability can keep a number of dice containing 0 up to your ranks in Command.

name: Hiruma Scout School
abilityText: After performing an Attack action, you may change your stance. If you do, increase the TN of Attack checks by creatures of silhouette 3 or larger targeting you by your school rank until the start of your next turn.
masteryAbility: Compromised characters affected by your school ability can keep a number of dice containing Strife up to your ranks in Command.

name: Kaiu Engineer School
abilityText: Once per scene, when making a check to use an item you personally crafted, you may add a number of kept black dices set to Opportunity results equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: When you construct an item, you may add or remove one quality from the item. You must describe to the GM how the item possesses (or lacks) the usual quality, and the GM is the final arbiter of whether an addition (or subtraction) is appropriate.

name: Kaiu Architect School
abilityText: Reduce the TN of your checks for downtime activities that alter your environment (such as checks to redecorate a room, build a fence, or erect a fortification) by your school rank (to a minimum of 1). When you succeed at such a check, you may choose a number of mundane terrain qualities equal to your school rank and add or remove those terrain q ualities from the area you affect.
masteryAbility: Once per game session, you can use your school ability on any check (action or down time activity) to alter your environment (such as a check to reposition a painting to change the atmosphere of a room or a check to obscure a trap with sand). When you do, you may also add or remove one supernatural terrain quality from the area you affect.

name: Kuni Purifier School
abilityText: Once per round, when you make a check targeting or involving a Tainted being, you may choose a number of your kept dice up to your school rank containing Strife symbols. Set each of these dice to a Success result. You cannot use this ability if you are unsure if a being is Tainted or not.
masteryAbility: Once per game session, you may spend 1 Void point to wield an invocation against all the wicked in your sight. Instead of affecting its usual targets, the next invocation technique you perform targets each Tainted being in range.

name: Kuni Warden School
abilityText: When you perform an Attack action check using Martial Arts [Melee] or Martial Arts [Unarmed], you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1+: One character per Opportunity spent this way who is in range of the weapon you used suffers the Silenced condition. You can spend a maximum number of Opportunities this way up to your school rank.
masteryAbility: All of your kihō gain the following additional burst effect: If you have 3 or more bonus successes, your unarmed attack profiles gain the Sacred quality until the end of your next turn.

name: Yasuki Merchant School
abilityText: As a downtime activity, if you have access to a market, you may acquire a number of items up to your school rank of rarity 4 or lower, or a single item of up to rarity 4 plus your school rank. You do not need to make a check or expend money to acquire these items, nor do you need to forfeit or stake honor or glory for the act of acquiring them, even if they are not befitting of your station or Forbidden (though displaying them openly later is a different matter). The GM can still apply rarity adjustments as usual based on the specifics of the market available.
masteryAbility: Once per game session, you may give away one item in your possession to reduce the TN of the next Social skill check you make targeting the recipient by an amount equal to the rarity of the item. For each point by which this would reduce the TN below 1, add a kept black dice set to an Opportunity result to your check.

name: Yasuki Yōjimbō School
abilityText: When you successfully perform the Guard action (page 264 of the core rulebook), When you make a check to perform the Guard action, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1+: If you succeed, you may guard one additional character in range per Opportunity spent this way. You can spend a maximum number of Opportunity this way up to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per game session, when you perform the Challenge action (page 263 of the core rulebook), you may choose up to 6 additional characters who can hear you as targets. These targets must have status lower than or equal to your original target's. If you succeed, each target must fight you in a clash one at a time in an order of their choosing (or flee the battle). Each clash lasts one round. After each clash, you regain fatigue equal to your Earth Ring. Until all of these clashes have concluded (or you have been killed), none of your targets can perform Attack or Scheme actions outside of their individual clashes.

name: Asahina Artificier School
abilityText: When making a check to mystically summon an illusion or to summon, augment, or awaken an object, you may add a number of kept black dices set to Opportunity results equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per game session as a downtime activity, you may make a TN 4 Artisan (Void) check to awaken an item’s spirit. If you succeed, until the end of the game session, it becomes a nemuranai with a sealed invocation of your choice based on the item’s history. The GM is the final arbiter of the appropriateness of any invocation selected this way.

name: Asahina Envoy School
abilityText: When you make a check to perform a ritual, you may add kept black dices set to Opoortunity results equal to your school rank. You may spend these Opportunities as if the ritual were also a Social skill check of your choice (such as to activate a shūji, etc.)
masteryAbility: When making a check to perform a ritual, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1+: One participant in the ritual with vigilance lower than or equal to Opportunities spent this way feels especially indebted to you. You gain the Ally [that character] advantage.

name: Daidoji Iron Warrior School
abilityText: Once per round, when another character within range of one of your readied melee weapons would suffer physical damage, you may intercept. If you do, you may suffer fatigue up to your school rank to reduce the damage the target suffers by twice that amount.
masteryAbility: When you use the Guard action, instead of guarding one character, you may choose to guard a number of other characters in range up to your ranks in Martial Arts [Melee].

name: Daidoji Spymaster School
abilityText: Once per scene, when making a check for a Scheme action targeting another character, you may receive a number of strife up to your school rank to reduce the TN by that amount (to a minimum of 1).
masteryAbility: As a downtime activity in any place of human habitation, you may make a TN 4 Skulduggery check to find an agent of the Daidoji spy network. If you succeed, you find this individual among the inhabitants of the city and gain the Ally advantage for them. If you succeed with 2 or more bonus successes, the individual may occupy a low-to-mid-level position in a household or organization of your choosing.

name: Daidoji Harrier School
abilityText: After you perform an Attach action against a target who is Dazed or unaware of your presence, that target receives strife equal to your school rank. If your target is an enemy leader's cohort in a mass battle, the enemy army also receives that much panic.
masteryAbility: After you use your school ability during a duel or skirmish, your target and each other character friendly to them at range 0-3 suffers the Dazed condition. After you use your school ability in a mass battle, the leader of the cohort you targeted suffers the Dazed condition.

name: Doji Diplomat School
abilityText: Once per scene when making a check to persuade or influence someone, you may add a number of kept black dices set to a Opportunity results equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per scene, you may spend 1 Void point to reduce your strife to 0. When you do, each friendly character in the scene may reduce their strife by your honor rank.

name: Doji Bureaucrat School
abilityText: When you cause a character to receive strife as a result of a check using a social approach, that character suffers additional strife equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per game session as a Scheme and Support action, you may make a TN 3 Government (Earth) check. If you succeed, you reveal a huge legal loophole or arcane precedent that legally justifies the actions of you and your allies during the scene. Others can refuse to accept your logic, but must forfeit honor equal to your ranks in Government plus your bonus successes to do so.

name: Kakita Duelist School
abilityText: Once per round, you may increase or decrease the severity of a critical strike you inflict by an amount up to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per scene, as an Attack and Movement action, you may make a Martial Arts [Melee] (Void) check targeting one character at range 2–3 using a sheathed katana or wakizashi. The TN of this check is equal to your target’s vigilance. You immediately move to range 1 of your target and draw the weapon you used. If you succeed, your target suffers a critical strike with severity equal to the deadliness of your weapon plus your bonus successes. Opportunity+: One character of your choice at range 0–2 of your target per Opportunity spent this way suffers the Dazed and Disoriented conditions. 2 Opportunities+: Treat the maximum range of this technique as 1 higher per 2 Opportunities spent this way.

name: Kakita Swordsmith School
abilityText: Once per game session when you make a check to craft, improve, or maintain a weapon, you may add a number of kept black dices set to Opportunity results equal to your school rank
masteryAbility: When you create a new weapon, you may apply two different patterns that you know to it (instead of one).

name: Agasha Mistic School
abilityText: When performing an invocation, you may choose a different ring with which to make the check. While using this school ability, you cannot activate Opportunity of the original Element of the invocation, but you can activate Opportunity for the new Element. You can use this school ability a number of times per game session up to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Increase your supernatural resistance against Air, Earth, Fire, and Water invocations by your ranks in Theology. After another character performs an Air, Earth, Fire, or Water invocation targeting you, you may spend 1 Void Point to immediately perform that invocation, even if you have not learned it.

name: Agasha Alchemist School
abilityText: You can have a number of additional potions with prepared invocations (see page 190 of the core rulebook) equal to your school rank. When you spend a downtime activity creating a potion, you may make a number of supp lemental checks after the first to create additional potions equal to your school rank, but each check must be for a different invocation.
masteryAbility: Once per game session as a Support act ion, you may make a TN 4 Medicine (Water) check to combine two of your potions that share at least one invocation effect keyword (mend, purify, smite, etc.) If you succeed, the two botions become a single concoction with both properties; when this concoction is used, resolve the effects of both of the prepared invocations t hat are part of it. A concoction cannot be combined with another potion or concoction.

name: Agasha Ascetic School
abilityText: After you channel an invocation, increase your physical and supernatural resistance by an amount equal to the number of dice you reserved, to a maximum of your school rank. This effect persist until the start of your next turn.
masteryAbility: When you successfully make a check to augment or mend a target, add a number of bonus successes equal to your ranks in Fitness.

name: Kitsuki Investigator School
abilityText: When performing a check to investigate with any skill (see The Art of Investigation, on page 170), you may treat your ranks in the skill you are using as being equal to your school rank. If your ranks in the skill are equal to or higher than your school rank, or if you have 5 ranks in the skill, you may add a kept black dices set to an Opportunity result instead.
masteryAbility: Once per scene when performing a skill check to investigate, you may spend Opprotunities as follows: 1+: You may reserve up to one dropped die per Opprtunity spent this way. The next time you perform a check to interact with the person or thing you were investigating (such as a check targeting that person or a check to use that object), you may add any number of these reserved dice as kept dice. Then, remove any unused reserved dice.

name: Mirumoto Two-Heavens Adept School
abilityText: Once per round during a duel or skirmish when you are targeted by an Attack check with a melee weapon, you may use one of your weapons readied in a one-handed grip (or one of your hands, if it is empty) to ward or trap. If you ward, the attacker must reroll dice containing Success or Exploding Success up to your school rank. If you trap, reduce the TN of your next Attack check against the attacker this scene by your school rank (to a minimum of 1). You cannot choose this weapon for Attack actions until the end of your next turn.
masteryAbility: Once per round, when performing an Attack action check, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1: Perform a Strike action with a readied weapon you have not used for an Attack action this turn.

name: Mirumoto Taoist Blade School
abilityText: Your kihō that affect your unarmed attack profiles also apply to weapons you wield in a one-handed grip. When you succeed on a check to activate a kihō that affects your unarmed attack profiles or a weapon you wield in a one-handed grip, add bonus successes equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: When making a check to active a kihō, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1: If you succeed on this check, after you activate the kihō, you may perform a Strike action with a weapon you have readied in a one-handed grip.

name: Togashi Tattooed Order
abilityText: You have one mystical tattoo that empowers your kihō, and gain more as your school rank increases. When you make a check to activate a kihō linked to one of your mystical tattoos, if you succeed, add additional bonus successes equal to your school rank. Select a natural motif for your first tattoo and choose one kihō for which you meet the prerequisites that are linked to the tattoo. If you have not learned it, you learn that kihō (without paying its XP cost). You cannot choose the same kihō multiple times this way. Each time your school rank increases, you gain one additional tattoo this way.
masteryAbility: Once per scene, while you are benefiting from the enhancement effect of a kihō linked to one of your tattoos, when you activate a different kihō, you may spend 1 Void point. If you do, you may maintain both enhancement effects until the end of the scene or until you activate another kihō.

name: Togashi Chronicler School
abilityText: Once per scene after you succeed on a Social skill check, you may choose a kihō with a prerequisite up to your school rank (whether you know it or not). You gain the benefits of its Enhancement Effect (see Kihō on page 183 of the core rulebook) as if you had successfully activated it. This effect persists until the end of the scene.
masteryAbility: When you use your school ability, you may choose a number of characters up to your ranks in Performance who can hear you. Each chosen character also gains the benefits of the kihō's enhancement effect as long as it persists on you.

name: Akodo Commander School
abilityText: When you succeed at an Attack or Support action check, you may remove an amount of strife from yourself up to your school rank. For each strife you remove this way, add that one bonus success to the check and receive 1 fatigue.
masteryAbility: Once per game session during a skirmish or mass battle, after you fail a check, you may attempt the check again, treating the TN as 1.

name: Akodo Soldier School
abilityText: When making an Attack or Movement action check, you may remove an amount of strife from yourself up to your school rank. For each strife you remove, add one kept black dice set to opportunity to the check and receive 1 fatigue.
masteryAbility: When you succeed at an Attack or Movement action check, you may spend 1 Void point to add bonus successes equal to your ranks in Fitness.

name: Ikoma Bard School
abilityText: Once per scene, after you perform a check using a Social skill that targets one or more characters, you may agitate or console: If you agitate, transfer strife up to twice your school rank from yourself to your targets (divided among them as you choose). If you console, transfer strife up to twice your school rank from your targets (divided among them as you choose) to yourself.
masteryAbility: Once per game session as a Support action, you may attempt to convince everyone in the scene of the glorious reputation of one character, embellishing the truth as needed, by making a TN 5 Performance (Fire) check targeting one character. The TN of this check is 6 if you target yourself, and 4 if you target another Lion Clan character. If you succeed, reduce the TN of all of the character’s Social skill checks by 3 until the end of the scene, and the TN of all of the character’s other checks by 1.

name: Ikoma Shadow School
abilityText: Once per scene when performing a check, you may stake an amount of honor no greater than your school rank to re-roll a number of dice equal to twice the amount of honor staked. For each re-rolled die result that does not contain a Success or Exploding Success, you forfeit one staked honor.
masteryAbility: Once per session after failing a Martial or Social check, you may stake up to 5 honor and immediately attempt the check again, adding black dices equal to the honor staked. If you fail, you forfeit all honor staked. If you succeed, you instead gain 1 honor and 1 glory.

name: Kitsu Medium School
abilityText: Once per scene, you may importune one invocation (see Importune Invocations, on page 189) with a school rank prerequisite up to your school rank without making the sacrifices usually required and without the usual TN increase
masteryAbility: Once per game session, as a Support action, you may summon the spirit of an ancestor to possess you until the end of the scene. While possessed, you count as an Otherworldly being and use the profile of the ancestor (a non-specific human NPC profile such as the Venerable Provincial Daimyō, or, at the GM’s discretion, a PC with up to 180 XP that you have created in advance). Your character does not remember any time they spend possessed.

name: Kitsu Medic School
abilityText: When you perform a Medicine check to remove fatigue or a condition from a friendly character, that character removes additional fatigue up to your school rank
masteryAbility: When you make a check to remove a condition from another character, you may receive 2 fatigue to treat the TN as 1.

name: Kitsu Realm Wanderer School
abilityText: As a Support action, you may make a TN 2 Meditation (Void) check to draw one of the Spirit Realms closer to your current location. A number of range bands around your current position up to your school rank become a place of power of the realm you choose (see page 138 for more information). This effect persists until the end of the scene.
masteryAbility: When you use your school ability in a place already linked to a particular realm, such as a place of power, you may move yourself and a number of characters up to your ranks in Meditation into that realm fully, leaving the Mortal Realm entirely. As a Support action, you may make a TN 2 Meditation (Void) check to return yourself and a number of characters up to your ranks in Meditation to the Mortal Realm.

name: Matsu Berserk School
abilityText: After you suffer a critical strike or unmask, you may suffer the Enraged condition to remove an amount of fatigue from yourself equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per round, when performing an Attack action check while Enraged, you may spend 1 Void point to alter each kept die containing Succes to a result containing Exploding Success.

name: Matsu Beastmaster School
abilityText: Increase each of your bonded animals endurance, composure and ranks in Martial skill group by an amount equal to your school rank (its skill ranks still cannot exceed 5). If bondedn animal is a minion, it becomes an adversary instead.
masteryName: With the Soul of a Lion
masteryAbility: After you perform an Attack action, each of your bonded animals may perform an Attack action against the same target, if able. If your attack action did not succeed, reduce the TN of each of your bonded animals' Attack action check by 2.

name: Asako Loremaster School
abilityText: When performing a Scholar skill check, you may treat your ranks in the skill as being equal to your school rank. If your ranks in that Scholar skill are equal to or higher than your school rank, or if you have 5 ranks in the skill, you may add one kept black dices set to an Opportunity result instead.
masteryAbility: After you succeed at a check to acquire or remember information, you may spend 1 Void point and choose any number of characters with whom you can communicate. You must describe how the knowledge you acquired helps each character you choose. Each of those characters reduces the TN of their next check by 1 (to a minimum of 1) and suffers 1 strife.

name: Asako Inquisitor School
abilityText: Once per scene as a Support action, you may scry to detect any supernatural abilities used at range 0–3 in the last day (such as invocations, mahō, and kihō). Reduce the TN of your checks to investigate this phenomenon by your school rank.
masteryAbility: When you make a check to investigate a supernatural phenomenon, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1+: Increase your resistance against that phenomenon (such as a specific invocation, kihō, mahō, or NPC ability) by an amount equal to the Opportunity you spend this way. This effect persists until the end of the scene.

name: Isawa Elementalist School
abilityText: Once per scene when making the check to activate an invocation technique, before rolling dice, you may reduce the TN of the check by your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per round, after you perform an invocation, you may spend 1 Void point to switch to any other stance and perform another invocation that shares no action types with the first invocation (Attack, Support, etc.).

name: Isawa Tensai School
abilityText: Choose one element (air, earth, fire, water or void) that will be your inspired element. When maikng a check to activate an invocation of your inspired element, add a number of rolled black dices set to opportunity results equal to your school rank. When making a check to activate an invocation of your inspired element, you trigger spiritual backlash only if you keep four or more dice containg strife symbols. When making a check to activate an invocation not of your inspired element, you trigger spiritual backlash if you keep two or more dice containg strife symbols.
masteryAbility: Once per scene, when making a check to activate an invocation of your inspired element, you may spend 1 Void point. If you do, you may keep any number of your rolled dice (instead of a number up to your ring value).

name: Shiba Guardian School
abilityText: Once per scene, when a character at range 0–3 makes a check that contains 1 or more Strife symbols, you may negate all of those Strife symbols. Then, that character removes strife and fatigue equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: At the end of your turn, you may spend 1 Void point to prepare to fend off advancing foes; this effect persists until the start of your next turn. When an enemy enters the range of one of your readied weapons, you may immediately make a Strike action using that weapon and targeting that enemy; if you succeed, the target suffers the Immobilized condition in addition to any other effects.

name: Shiba Artist School
abilityText: Once per scene after you succeed at an Artisan skill check, you may choose a number of characters in the scene equal to your school rank. Each chosen character removes 3 strife.
masteryAbility: When you use your school ability, you may remove one or more of the following conditions from each chosen character: Dazed, Disoriented, Enraged, Exhausted, Intoxicated. Additionally, each chosen character removes 3 fatigue.

name: Kaito Shrine Keeper School
abilityText: As an action, you may augment one of your arrows with a prayer to the kami. Make the check to perform one invocation you know, reducing the TN by your school rank, and record the result. The arrow gains the Sacred quality, and remains infused with the invocation until the end of the scene. After you perform an Attack action using the arrow (or fire it at a location, at the GM’s discretion), you may resolve the effects of the invocation from the place the arrow landed. You may spend Opportunities to delay resolving the effects of the invocation for 1 round per Opportunity spent this way, and may spend 2 Opportunities from a failed check to affect one target of the attack that you missed.
masteryAbility: As an action, you may make a TN 3 Meditation (Void) check by plucking the string of a bow you are wielding, targeting each Otherworldly being within a number of range bands equal to your ranks in Meditation. If you succeed, each target suffers strife equal to your ranks in Meditation plus your bonus successes. Opportunity: Each target must resist with a TN 3 Meditation (Void) check or treat its physical and supernatural resistances as 0. This effect persists until the end of the scene.

name: Kaito Spirit Seeker School
abilityText: When you are in the presence of a kami (such as an elemental kami or other Supernatural being the GM deems appropriate), you may make a TN 4 Courtesy check using a ring associated with the kami's element (its highest ring) or one of its elements (if it has multiple highest rings). If you fail, you suffer 3 fatigue and 3 strife and cannot attempt to act as a vessel again this session. If you succeed, you convince the kami to use your body as a vessel. This grants you the following: - Any time you make a check using one of the kami's elements, you may reroll a number of dice up to your school rank - Any time you make a check using one of the kami's opposing elements, increase the TN by 1 and add one kept black dice set to Opportunity Strife - If you unmask, the kami is released (see Releasing Kami).
masteryAbility: You may keep two kami within you at once instead of one. All effects of The Body Is a Shrine still apply. If two kami share an element, the effects do not stack for that element.

name: Bayushi Manipulator School
abilityText: When you exploit a target’s disadvantage (see Turning Advantages and Disadvantages, page 100) as part of a Scheme action, you do not need to spend a Void point, and you may reroll additional dice up to your school rank.
masteryAbility: When you perform a check targeting another character to which one of your advantages or disadvantages applies, you may choose another advantage or disadvantage that shares a type with it. Unless they have clear evidence to the contrary, the target comes to believe that you have the advantage or disadvantage you chose instead of the one you actually have. If the target attempts to seize or exploit this false advantage or disadvantage, their check automatically counts as failing with a shortfall of 3. They suffer 3 strife and the Disoriented condition.

name: Bayushi Deathdealer School
abilityText: When you exploit a target’s disadvantage (see Turning Advantages and Disadvantages, page 100 of the core rulebook) as part of an Initiative check for a duel or an Attack action, you do not need to spend a Void point, and you may reroll additional dice up to your school rank.
masteryAbility: When you inflict a critical strike during a duel or skirmish, treat the deadliness of your weapon as increased by the difference between your initiative and your target's initiative (subtracting the lower of the two initiative values from the higher).

name: Shosuro Infiltrator School
abilityText: While performing an Attack action against a target who is Compromised, Incapacitated, Unconscious, or unaware of your presence, treat the damage and deadliness of your weapon as being increased by your school rank.
masteryAbility: As an Attack and Movement action, you may make a TN 4 Martial Arts [Unarmed] (Air) check targeting any number of minion NPCs at range 0–4. If you succeed during a narrative scene, you silently kill all targets over the course of a few minutes. If you succeed during a conflict scene, at the end of each of your turns, you may silently kill one of these targets at range 0–2 (in addition to your other actions).

name: Shosuro Shadowweaver School
abilityText: You do not suffer any ill effects of Obscuring terrain as a result of darkness (see page 267 of the core rulebook). When you perform an Attack or Scheme action check against a target in terrain that is Obscuring due to darkness, reduce the TN by your school rank (to a minimum of 1). As a Support action, you may target a position at range 0- 2 and summon a cloud of supernatural darkness there. An area around the target position extending a number of range bands equal to your Air Ring become Obscuring terrain. This effect persists a number of rounds equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per scene as an Attack and Movement action, you may summon a shadow assassin. The shadow has no corporeal form and cannot be harmed. At the end of each of your turns, you may perform a Strike action using one of your readied weapons targeting any character in the scene who is in Obscuring terrain (or other darkness, at the GM's discretion), regardless of range. Damage dealt this way is supernatural. This effect persists until the end of the scene.

name: Soshi Illustionist School
abilityText: While you are performing an invocation technique or channeling, characters with a vigilance lower than or equal to your school rank plus one cannot detect any physical sign that you are in the act of invoking the spirits. They can still observe effects of the invocation, however. Increase the TN of Theology checks to detect or study your supernatural activities by your school rank.
masteryAbility: You may spend 1 Void point to attempt to establish that something in the scene has been an illusion all along. This could be an object, image of a person, or other illusory phenomenon you could summon with an invocation. You must make the check to summon this illusion using an invocation, with adjustments to the TN for plausibility determined by the GM. If you succeed, you reveal that the thing you chose is in fact an illusion you wove, and has been for at least a few moments. If you fail, your character clearly did not think to set up an illusion — the object is as it appears. As with all matters, the GM has final say over acceptable uses of this ability.

name: Yogo Wardmaster School
abilityText: You can have a number of additional wards with prepared invocations (see page 190) up to your school rank. Decoding or using one of your wards requires any other character to make a Theology (Void) check with TN equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per scene, when you are targeted by an invocation or mahō technique, you may resist with a TN 4 Composition check. If you succeed, you absorb the invocation or mahō, nullifying all of its effects and creating a ward containing it.

name: Yogo Preserver School
abilityText: You can have a number of additional shikigami (see page 115) up to your school rank. Once per scene, after you perform an action, you may instruct one of your shikigami to perform an action, for which it benefits from your assistance.
masteryAbility: When one of your shikigami performs an action, it may spend Opportunities as follows: 1+: Another one of your shikigami at range 0–3 of you may perform an action. Increase the Opportunities cost of this ability by Opportunity for each of your shikigami that has acted this turn.

name: Yogo Penitent Order
abilityText: Once per scene, after you defend against damage or suffer a critical strike, you may unleash your current kihō. Immediatelyend its enhancements effect, then resolve its burst effect asif you had a number of bonus successes equal to your school rank plus the amount of fatigue you received or the severity of the critical strike you suffered. If the burst effect has one or more targets, you may choose appropriate targets in range. If you have used this ability already this scene, you may spend 1 Void point to use it again this scene. You cand do this any number of times, provided you have Void points to spend.
masteryAbility: When you defend against damage, if all your Void Points are spent, treat your physical and supernatural resistances as being equal to your Void ring.

name: Ide Emissary School
abilityText: When you perform a Support action check, you may spend Opportunities (1+): Choose one character int he scene with vigilance lower than your school ranks plus Opportunities spent this way. You treat thata character's focus and vigilance each as 1 lower until the end of the scene.
masteryAbility: One per scene as a Support action, you may make a TN 3 Culture (Fire or Water) check targeting any number of other characters in the scene. If you succeed and you chose Fire, each character gains the Emboldened condition. If you succeed and you chose Water, each character removes 3 strife.

name: Ide Trader School
abilityText: Ignore the Forbidden quality when acquiring and handling items. When acquiring, selling, or gifting an item, you may treat its rarity as reduced or increased by your school rank.
masteryAbility: As a downtime activity in any place of human habitation, you may make a TN 4 Commerce (Water) check to find a merchant with whom you (or your relatives) have done business. If you succeed, you find this individual and gain the Ally advantage for them, which predisposes them to assist you in various ways.

name: Ide Messenger School
abilityText: After you make a check for Initiative (or enter, for a narrative scene), you may choose another character in the scene. That character removes strife equal to your school rank, and you reduce the TN of your next Social skill check targeting that character by 2.
masteryAbility: When you make a Social skill check, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 2: Choose another character's social objective that you know. You may transfer any number of momentum points you have accrued to the completion of their objective. After that character completes their objective, you gain the Support of [That Character's Group] advantage if you do not have it already.

name: Iuchi Horse Lord Disciple
abilityText: When you make a check to craft, improve, or maintain an item, you may imprint it with the Horse Lord's Favor, giving it one of your advantages or disadvantages. If the item is a meishōdō talisman, you may instead give the item an advantage or disadvantage from its sealed spirit. While an item with your Horse Lor's Favor adorns a horse or a creature with the Loyal Steed ability, the horse or creature is Otherworldly and possesses the chosen advantage or disadvantage. If the item is a meishōdō talisman, the horse or creature may perform any techniques it contains. You can sustain a number of items with your Horse Lord's Favor up to your school rank. Additionaly, when you perform a Medicine check to remove fatigue or a condition from a horse or other equine creature, add bonus successes equal to you school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per scene, you may spend 1 Void point to target any non-Shadowlands creature of silhouette 3 or greater, giving the target the Loyal Steed sbility - it can be riden by a human-sized (silhouette 2 or lower) rider - until the end of the scene. When you do, you may make a Courtesy (Water) ot Theology (Void) check with a TN equal to target's vigilance. If you succeed on the check, the target is favorable toward you and willing to be ridden. Horses of the Blessed Herd - the Utaku steeds - are immune to this mastery ability.

name: Iuchi Meishōdō Master School
abilityText: As a downtime activity, you may make a TN 2 Design check using any ring to bind a spirit to an inanimate vessel, creating a meishōdō talisman for one invocation of that Element that you have learned. While you have the talisman in your possession, reduce the TN of checks to activate that invocation by 1. You can give the talisman to another shugenja, allowing them to perform that invocation even if they have not learned it and reducing the TN to activate it by 1, but the talisman ceases to function after a number of uses equal to your school rank. You can sustain a number of meishōdō talismans up to your school rank. You can only have one meishōdō talisman for any single invocation
masteryAbility: At the end of your turn, you may spend 1 or more Void points to unleash the powers within an equal number of your meishōdō talismans, destroying these talismans and freeing the entities within. You may immediately perform each of the invocations for which the talismans were created, reducing the TN by 3.

name: Moto Conqueror School
abilityText: When performing an Attack action during a skirmish or mass battle, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1: Choose an enemy other than your target whom you can perceive. Increase the TN of that enemy’s Attack checks targeting you by your school rank until the start of your next turn.
masteryAbility: Once per round, after you inflict the Incapacitated condition on a target (or defeat a minion NPC), you may perform a Strike action against a different target.

name: Moto Avenger School
abilityText: When you perform an invocation that targets at least one other character, if you succeed, you may nourish or drain: If you nourish, you may receive fatigue up to your school rank. One target removes fatigue equal to the amount you received. If you drain, you may remove an amount of fatigue from yourself up to your school rank. One target receives fatigue equal to the amount you removed.
techniques: Air and Earth Invocations, Rituals, Shūji
masteryAbility: When you nourish, you may remove one condition the target is suffering by transferring it to yourself. When you drain, you may remove one condition you are suffering by transferring it to one of your targets.

name: Shinjo Mounted Archer
abilityText: When you spend a Void to seize the moment during a check using a bow, you may negate stress symbols up to your school rank. If you succeed, gain bonus successes equal to the number of stress symbels you negated. Additionaly, while you are riding your speed, all of your Martial Arts [Ranged] and Performance skill checks have unskilled assistance.
masteryAbility: Any steed you ride gains +4 Endurance, +2 Composure, +1 Vigilance, and the Resplendentitem quality. When you spend 1 or more Void points during a Martial Arts [Ranged] or Performance check, an item you have equipped gains the Sacred and Hewing item qualities, and you add a number of kept Ring dice set to Opportunity results equal to your Void ring.

name: Shinjo Outrider School
abilityText: Once per scene, before rolling dice, you may declare that you are directing your horse (who must be present) to aid in a task and describe how its efforts help in those circumstances. Reduce the TN of the check by your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per game session, you may call out for your steed. At the beginning of the following round, your horse arrives, regardless of any barriers that might normally have prevented it from reaching your location. If your steed has recently been slain, its spirit will possess the closest horse to you and come to your aid regardless, such is its loyalty to you.

name: Utaku Battle Maiden School
abilityText: When you succeed at an Attack action check, add bonus successes equal to the number of range bands you have moved this round, to a maximum of your school rank. During a duel or mass battle, if you are mounted on your steed, you always count as having moved a number of range bands equal to your school rank this turn.
masteryAbility: Once per round, after you defend against damage, you may move 1 range band and you may switch to a different stance.

name: Utaku Silent Shadow Yojimbō
abilityText: When you make a check to perform the Guard action, you gain a bonus success if you or your target is mounted on a steed. Additionaly, when you succeed on a check to perform the Guard action, you may spend Opportunities 1+:: Give a targetat range 0-3 the Emboldened condition (see page 133). You can spend a maximum number of Opportunities this way up to your school rank.
masteryAbility: You may use the Guard action during intrigues. When you do, increase the TN of Scheme action checks against the guarded target by 1, plus an additional 1 per two bonus successes.

name: Utaku Stablemaster School
abilityText: When you make a check to handle, calm, or instruct an animal or beast, you may negate a number of Q results equal to your school rank. Additionally, once per scene as a Support action, you may make a TN 2 Survival (Water) or Theology (Water) check. If you succeed, you discover a ridable animal with a combat (f.l)conflict rank of 3 or lower and that is appropriate to the environment. It is friendly toward you and gives you all of the benefits of a mount (see page 326 of the core rulebook), but its Water Ring is increased by your bonus successes (to a maximum value of 6).
techniques: Kata, Rituals, Water and Air Invocations
masteryAbility: Once per game as a Support action, you may summon a number of animals equal to your Water Ring that are combat conflict rank 3 or lower. These animals appear from the local environment. They are friendly to you and do their best to fulfill your commands. These animals stay to assist you until the end of the scene. If an animal becomes Compromised or incapacitated, it flees back into the wilds. The GM is the final arbiter over what types of animals, if any, are available in a given environment, as well as whether animals remain after the end of the scene.

name: Miya Cartographer School
abilityText: You always know which way is north, and you are always able to find a landmark useful for navigation. When making a check to recall or ascertain geographical, political, or societal information, you may add a number of kept black dices set to Opportunity or Success results equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per scene as a Support action, you may make a TN 1 Survival (Earth) check targeting one character in the scene. If you succeed on the check, that character and an additional number of characters you choose equal to your bonus successes ignore all negative effects of terrain qualities until the end of the scene.

name: Miya Herald School
abilityText: Once per round, after a character at range 0–4 succeeds on an Attack or Scheme action check, you may cause them to receive strife equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per scene as a Scheme action, you may make a TN 4 Command (Air) check targeting a number of characters in the scene up to your glory rank. If you succeed, until the end of the scene, the targets must forfeit honor equal to twice their honor rank and glory equal to twice their glory rank before choosing you as the target of an Attack action, and increase the TN of their Attack actions targeting you by 2. This effect persists until the end of the scene, or until you attack an affected character or their allies. Opportunity+: Choose one ally per Opportunity spent this way. The effects of this ability also apply to targets’attacks against the chosen allies.

name: Otomo Schemer School
abilityText: You never forfeit honor or glory in order to lie or deceive for the good of the Emperor and Empire (in your opinion). However, you must forfeit twice as much honor or glory to lie for your personal gain (again, in your opinion). When a character stakes or forfeits an amount of honor or glory in order to act against your desires, you may force them to increase that amount by your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per scene, as a Scheme action, you may make a Command (Water) check targeting any number of characters at range 0–5 of you. The TN of this check is equal to the highest status rank among your targets. If you succeed, all targets suffer the Dazed and Disoriented conditions.

name: Seppun Astrologer School
abilityText: At the beginning of a game session or as a downtime activity, you may make a TN 1 Theology check using any ring. If you succeed, choose a number of kept dice up to your school rank to reserve. Until the end of the game session or the next downtime scene, when any character makes a skill check using the chosen ring, you may replace one or more kept dice with the same number of reserved dice of the same type.
masteryAbility: Once per game session, you may spend 1 Void point to reveal that you have foreseen an event in the current scene. You may retroactively declare one or more preparations you have taken, subject to the GM’s approval. If any preparations would require a skill check, such as the preparation of a ward, you make the check when you use this ability.

name: Seppun Palace Guard School
abilityText: When you succeed on an Initiative check during a skirmish or duel, add bonus successes equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per round, you may spend 1 Void point to add bonus successes equal to your honor rank to a successful Attack or Support action check.

name: Kasuga Smuggler School
abilityText: You never need to stake glory to publicly use a Trade skill, so long as you are doing so as part of your duty to your clan; Once per scene, you may add a number of kept black dices set to Opportunity results equal to your school rank to a check to interact with one or more gaijin, peasants, merchants, burakumin, or any other character with status of 20 or lower.
masteryAbility: Once per game session as an action, you may invoke the shell of the Tortoise: the Emperor's remit to operate as you deem necessary. Until the end of the scene, treat your status as 90, and other characters must forfeit honor and g lory equal to the difference between your status rank and their status rank to accuse you of wrongdoing related to the acquisition or transport of goods, illicit or otherwise.

name: Storm Fleet Sailor School
abilityText: Once per round when making a Trade skill check, if you are not Compromised, you may receive a number of strife up to your school rank to reroll that many rolled dice.
masteryAbility: You may receive 1 additional strife to use your Sailor’s Fortune ability on any check instead of only a Trade skill check.

name: Storm Fleet Tide Seer School
abilityText: When an invocation technique you perform would affect "each character" or "each other character" at a specified range, you may exclude a number of characters up to your school rank from all effects of the invocation, including spiritual backlash (see page 190 of the core rulebook).
techniques: Air and Water Invocations, Rituals, Shūji
masteryAbility: When you perform an invocation that smites one or more targets, treat each target’s supernatural resistance as 1 lower per kept Strife symbol on the check.

name: Toritaka Phantom Hunter School
abilityText: Otherworldly beings treat your vigilance as being increased by your school rank. When you make a check to search for Otherworldly beings, or make an Initiative check in a conflict against them, if you succeed, add bonus successes equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: You can perceive beings that are normally invisible to human sight, such as spirits and characters concealed by supernatural abilities. When you deal damage to an Otherwordly being, you ignore an amount of its resistance up to your ranks in Meditation.

name: Mazoku's Enforcer Tradition
abilityText: When you perform an Attack or Scheme action check targeting an Otherworldly being, if you succeed, add a number of bonus successes equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: When making a check targeting an Otherworldly being, you may seize one of its advantages by receiving 2 fatigue instead of spending 1 Void point. If you do, your target receives strife equal to your ranks in Command.

name: Shika Matchmaker School
abilityText: You may perform The Ties that Bind ritual as an action, instead of as a downtime activity. When you make a check to perform this ritual, you may add kept black dices set to Opportunity results equal to your school rank.
techniques: Air and Water Invocations, Rituals, Shūji
masteryAbility: Once per scene, after successfully performing the Ties that Bind ritual, you may spend 1 Void point to catch a glimpse of all major future consequences of the relationship identified by the ritual. You also learn of one other relationship between your target and another character that will guarantee that the consequences you predict will not come to pass.

name: Shika Speardancer School
abilityText: When making a Martial Arts [Melee] or Fitness check, you may spend 2 Oppurtunities to cause a number of characters no greater than your school rank and within range of your readied weapon to suffer the Dazed condition.
masteryAbility: When performing an Attack action using Martial Arts [Melee], you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1+: Choose one character other than your target at range 2 with vigilance lower than or equal to Opportunites spent this way. That character suffers a critical strike with severity equal to your weapon's deadliness plus your ranks in Martial Arts [Melee].

name: Moshi Sun Sentinel School
abilityText: Damage inflicted by your Fire invocations is treated as having the Sacred item quality. Items you augment or summon with Fire invocations have the Sacred quality. When you affect a non-Tainted human character with a Fire invocation, it does not deal damage to the target or inflict negative conditions. Instead, the character removes fatigue equal to your school rank plus the damage you would have dealt otherwise. Each character can only remove fatigue with this school ability once per scene.
masteryAbility: While performing a Fire invocation, you may spend a Void point to target additional characters equal to your ranks in Theology or to increase the maximum range of the technique by 1 range band.

name: Ichirō Grappler School
abilityText: After you succeed at an Attack action check using Martial Arts [Unarmed] skill, if the target is Immobilized or Prone, they also receive fatigue equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: When you inflict a critical strike on a target, if the target is Immobilized or Prone, you may receive 3 fatigue to increase the severity of the critical strike by two times your ranks in Fitness.

name: Ichirō Ironsmith School
abilityText: Once per game session when you make a check to craft, improve or maintain a weapon or set of armor, you may receive an amount of fatigue up to your school rank to reroll that many dice
masteryAbility: When you create a new set of armor, you may apply two different patterns you know to it (instead of one).

name: Dragonfly Grace of the Spirits School
abilityName: May the Spirits Show the Path
abilityText: Once per scene if you would fail a Social check, you may immediately make a TN 5 Theology check, with the TN being reduced by a number equal to your school rank (to a minimum of 1). If you succeed, you may change any kept black dice on that Social check to Success results instead.
masteryAbility: You may spend 1 Void point to use your school ability an additional time this scene. You may do this multiple times.

name: Kitsune Mediator School
abilityText: After a friendy character at range 0-4 receives strife, you may impose the Centered condition on that character (see page 133). You can use this school ability a number of times per scene up to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Friendly Centered characters at range 0-4 from you treat their composure and endurance as increased by your ranks in Courtesy.

name: Kitsune Naturalist School
abilityText: When you succeed on a check to activate an invocation, if it is the first invocation of that element you have activated this scene, you may add a number of bonus successes or kept dice set to Opportunities equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: After you resolve the effects of an invocation, if you have successfully activated at least one Air invocation, one Earth invocation, one Fire invocation and one Water invocation during this scene, you may have a number of characters in the scene up to your ranks in Survival each remove half their strife and half their fatigue (rounded up). You may use this ability only once pers scene.

name: Kitsune Impersonator Tradition
abilityText: Your true form is that of a large fox with up to eight tails if you are a full-blooded kitsune, or a human with certain vulpine traits if you possess human ancestry as well. As a Scheme and Support action, you may transform between your human and true forms, or into another silhouette 1 or 2 natural creature at the GM’s discretion (you cannot mimic specific individuals). Observers with vigilance lower than or equal to your school rank plus your ranks in Performance do not detect any flaws in your façade. However, certain key features persist across all of your forms. If you become Compromised, your disguise slips, subtly revealing your true tails, ears, feet, or shadow.
masteryAbility: Your true form now has nine tails. While you are in your true form, your supernatural resistance and physical resistance each increase by 2, and when you make a skill check, you may alter the result of one die containing Success to a result containing Explosive Success. While you are in your true form, your Attack action checks gain the following new opportunity: 2: After resolving this action, if your target is Incapacitated or Unconscious, you devour or banish their body or soul, instantly killing them.

name: lshiken Initiate School
abilityText: When you make a check using your Void Ring, after rolling dice, you may receive a number of fatigue up to your school rank. If you do, you may pull or push: If you pull, choose a number of dice with non-blank results equal to the fatigue you received, and alter each to a blank result. If you push, choose a number of dice with blank results equal to the fatigue you received, and alter each to a non-blank result of your choice.
masteryAbility: Once per scene, after a character rolls dice, you may receive 3 fatigue to alter any number of their rolled dice to blank results.

name:
Champion of Days Gone
Tradition
abilityText: When making a check using a bow, add a number of kept black dices set to an Opportunity result equal to your school rank.
masteryAbility: Once per game session, before making a check with a bow, you may declare your confidence in a shot and stake up to 6 glory upon hitting your mark. Reduce the TN of the check by that amount. If you succeed, you recover your staked glory. If succeeding in the shot would cause you to receive a glory award (such as if you were competing with another skilled archer, or felled a dangerous beast on the hunt), you receive that amount of glory plus 3 instead. If you fail, you lose your staked glory.
